mechanism: The changed remainingStock calculation subtracts actual consumption without the zero clamp, so recorded stock 100 g and actual use 130 g leaves -30 g instead of 0 g.
trigger: The spool estimate is 100 g and the completed print consumed 130 g.
expectedBehavior: The estimate is clamped to 0 g when consumption exceeds the recorded estimate.
incorrectBehavior: The remaining estimate becomes -30 g, an invalid negative stock value.
reproduction: Call the before and after fixture with {"recorded": 100, "actual": 130}; compare the result to verify the described behavior.
unacceptableAllegations: the fixture directly executes a production database migration
the fixture proves unrelated application behavior
